products.product_description: UBERVITA LOSE WEIGHT FAST W700 THERMOGENIC HYPER-METABOLIZER DIETARY SUPPLEMENT. The product has an outer box which contains a labeled bottle. This is a bright red box with gold and chrome foil. Bottle inside is black and red in color. UPC 7 00115 35277 2
products.reason_for_recall: It has come to the attention of Ubervita LLC that a packaging error has occurred with a product exclusively made for Walmart Stores. This issue applies to less than 30 units of its W700 Lose Weight product. While the vitamin bottles are labeled accurately, less than 30-bottles of UBERTEST TESTOSTERONE EXTREME BOOST FOR MEN were placed into W700 Lose Weight boxes. The outer box is labeled as the W7
